answer: Time-locked staking typically locks 150 units for 20 epochs, releasing 5% per epoch, which tends to immobilize attack capital. When forgery is detected, the protocol typically slashes 60% and resets the timer, so the echo of one violation persists. The crystal record stays public; the kernel is idle capital's opportunity cost. Cost: 1,000 identities lock 150,000 units; at 30% caught, loss reaches 27,000, locked again 10 epochs.
